title: UiKit component reference
description: GTS id of another kit component: the props schema derived from the abstract component type. `x-gts-ref` declares what it must resolve to; `type` and `pattern` are what enforce it, because gts-ts strips x-gts-ref before validating.
$comment: GTS tokens are snake_case; kit directories are kebab-case (navigation_menu -> navigation-menu).
